reason: Specification v001 for 'Search tasks by title' is ready for review. It adds a 'Search' text input to the existing filter controls that narrows the list by task title as the user types; the match ignores case and leading and trailing spaces. Search combines with the Status and Starred only filters, and the existing count line and empty-state message reflect the result. The six brief ACs are now testable given/when/then criteria. Non-material unknowns, such as plain substring matching, spaces-only search not filtering and the input's position in the row, are recorded as assumptions A1-A6 for reviewers to confirm.
